notes.title: 🟣 Shoot & Neon – Version 1.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
After months of development, playtesting, and community feedback, Shoot & Neon has reached a major milestone. This update marks the final step before the official Steam launch on June 4th. It's time to polish things up, squash the last bugs, and get ready for takeoff!

🔧 What's New in v1.0
✅ Player bullets now pass through teammates — no more accidental blocking.

✅ Lives system added — your team now shares a limited number of lives. Once they're gone, it's game over — no more infinite respawns.

✅ Lobby music added 

✅ Voting system improved — a visible timer starts when the first player votes.

✅ Upgrade UI updated — the “+” icon is now a bullet icon for clarity.

🐛 Bug Fixes
🐞 Fixed an issue where players could get stuck in a "hit loop".

🐞 Resolved a critical bug where the game would freeze if the host left.

🐞 Player synchronization improved — all players should now see each other correctly.

🐞 Achievements now work as intended — including the "no damage run" achievement.

🐞 Leaderboards now function correctly in multiplayer — and are now fully integrated with Steam.

⚠️ Known Issues
🔥 Fireballs still pass through building ramps — this bug remains unresolved for now.

🧭 Developer’s Note
This is the final feature update for Shoot & Neon. I'm shifting my focus to a new project, but may return for smaller updates if needed. It’s been a blast building this game, and I can’t wait to share it with more players on Steam.

🚀 Help Shoot & Neon Blast Off — June 4th!
Version 1.0 is ready — but your help before launch is key:
👉 Play it, test it, and break it — especially in multiplayer!
👉 Share it with friends and add it to your Steam wishlist

🗓️ Mark your calendars: Steam launch is June 4th
🎯 Every wishlist and bit of feedback makes a huge difference. Thank you!

notes.title: GAME UPDATE: Version 0.1 Live Now!
notes.content:
🚀 GAME UPDATE: Version 0.1 Live Now! 🌟

Waddup gamers,

Get ready for the latest game update - Version 0.1 is officially live! I have been hard at work to bring you exciting new features and improvements. Here's what's waiting for you in this update:

🌌 New Map: Brace yourselves for a visually stunning journey! Explore the revamped landscape adorned with magma shrooms and glistening crystals. Traverse dark ground rocks and climb towers.

🚶 Smaller Map Size: Say goodbye to endless walks! We've listened to your feedback and made the map more compact, ensuring you spend less time traversing and more time enjoying the neon-filled excitement.

💡 Neon-Points Despawn: Keep on your toes! Neon-points now have a limited lifespan, adding an extra layer of strategy to your gameplay. Grab them before they vanish and maximize your neon-powered potential!

🗺️ Minimap with Enhanced Visibility: Navigate the neon landscape with ease using our newly added minimap. Spot enemies, neon-points, players, and valuable pick-ups at a glance, giving you the upper hand in the fast-paced neon battleground.

🚀 Faster Leveling Up: Level up at a lightning pace! We've adjusted the progression system so you can unlock upgrades more frequently. Make strategic choices and tailor your playstyle as you climb the neon ranks.

🤝 Join Our Discord: Your feedback is invaluable to me! I invite you to share your thoughts, suggestions, and experiences on our Discord channel. Connect with fellow neon explorers, stay updated on development, and be part of the vibrant community driving the game forward.

https://discord.gg/WSKfvZV4xC

Download the update now and dive into the neon-soaked world of possibilities. Thank you for your continued support, and I can't wait to see you in the neon-lit battlegrounds!

Stay neon,
Germie

notes.title: Shoot & Neon version 0.0.6
notes.content:
Waddup gamers!

I am thrilled to announce a new update for the game that brings several bug fixes and improvements to enhance your gaming experience. Here's what you can expect in this update:

Bug Fixes:
1. Fixed an issue where the enemies head could still be hit by other joined players.
2. Resolved the problem causing the screen to stay red after taking damage.
3. Addressed a bug where the UI of other players would overlap with your own.
4. Fixed a bug where numbers displayed excessive decimal places; now they are rounded appropriately.
5. Health pickups have been reworked to prevent weird collisions, and might improve the games overall preformance.
6. Shooting speed now scales based on a percentage. The higher the percentage, the faster you shoot.
7. Fixed the bug where the cursor remained visible after selecting a team upgrade.
8. You can now safely return to the menu without encountering any issues if you're eliminated.

I appreciate your continued support and feedback as we work to provide the best possible gaming experience. These fixes should significantly improve your gameplay and make your time in the game world even more enjoyable.

Thank you for playing, and stay tuned for more exciting updates in the future!

Game on!
The gamedev

notes.title: Shoot & Neon version 0.0.5.5
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Here are the Patch Notes for the new update, LIVE NOW

Version 0.0.5.5

Features and Additions:
•    Added animations to the user interface, enhancing the overall visual experience.
•    Introducing spawning of black spheres upon impact with enemies.
•    Damage numbers are now displayed, providing better feedback during combat.
•    Enemies now have distinct weak points (headshots) that deal increased damage when hit.
•    Implemented a bugfix to address the issue of enemies continuing to track the player after their death.
•    Upon player death, a respawn timer of 10 seconds has been implemented.
•    Game over condition introduced when all players are simultaneously defeated (Note: In-development; pending addition of lobby, main menu, and leaderboard 
features).
•    Added chests containing upgrades that can be acquired throughout the game.
•    Resolved a bug related to movement speed, ensuring that sprinting provides a more noticeable speed boost.
•    Introduced collectible life items that players can pick up for extra lives.
•    Randomly spawning upgrades on the game map enhance gameplay variability.
•    Added a new game map to keep the experience fresh and exciting.
•    Fixed the issue where spheres would pass through walls, improving overall collision behavior.
•    Enhanced the upgrade notification system with a new pop-up display. Implemented a voting mechanism for upgrades where the most voted option is chosen.
Balancing and Adjustments:
•    Modified the game structure to consist of a single progressively challenging wave over time.

Please note that further updates are planned to introduce additional features such as the lobby, main menu, and leaderboard, which will contribute to a more comprehensive gaming experience. Your feedback is invaluable in shaping the future of the game. Enjoy the enhanced gameplay and keep an eye out for future updates!

Peece!
Germie

notes.title: Update 0.0.4.9
notes.content:
New build 0.0.4.9 Live with some important updates and bug fixes. Here are the changes you can expect:

- Fixed a bug where enemies were able to pass through the roof
- Added a difficulty scaler to make the game more challenging as you play with more players
- Fixed a bug where players who weren't the host experienced latency issues or their hits on enemies didn't register properly
- Added a hitmark and a crosshair to improve your accuracy and visual feedback
- Fixed a bug where enemies could still attack you after they were already defeated
- Achievements have been fixed and are now working properly

I hope these changes improve your experience with the game and I welcome your feedback! As always, thank you for playing and supporting the game.
